image_format.title: Image Format
image_format.description: File suffix of the images to convert. Every file with this suffix is converted, at any depth below the input dataset.

compression.title: Image Compression
compression.description: JPEG for images from brightfield slide scanners, which already hold lossy JPEG tiles written by the scanner; a lossless codec inflates the output substantially without recovering fidelity that was lost before the file was written. Prefer a lossless option (ZLIB, LZW, J2K, UNCOMPRESSED) for acquisitions that were never lossily compressed. JPEG needs an RGB or 8-bit image and J2K needs 8- or 16-bit; DEFAULT lets QuPath choose from the image itself.
